title: Follow the Norm: Accounting for Fine-Tuning and Prompt Effects on Model Rationales

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to high-conflict moral dilemmas (e.g., Fairness vs. Confidentiality, Honesty vs. Loyalty) using LLM-as-a-judge scoring, human qualitative auditing, and lexical transfer analysis to measure shifts from safety-compliant behavior to community-sourced, self-interested rationales.

Analyzing how specific community-driven norms (sourced from Reddit's r/AmITheAsshole) embedded in training datasets transfer downstream and alter an AI agent's justification patterns and moral vocabulary.
